analyzed: āptam prāptam kāle tam kurvanti āpta kāriṇaḥ vadhānavantaḥ ucyante śuddhānta adhikāriṇaḥ kañcukinaḥ taiḥ sve gṛhe ruddhāḥ ca asvatantrīkṛtāḥ yatheṣṭa vihāra niṣedhena rakṣyamāṇāḥ na rakṣitāḥ bhavanti kim tu ātmanā ātmānam rakṣanti tāḥ katham rakṣanti yadi eteṣu karyeṣu niyujyante ukta upāya praśaṃsā na upāya antara niṣedhaḥ

original: yasmin kasmiṃś ca puṃsi dṛṣṭe dhairyāc calanam — katham etena saṃprayujyeyeti — cetaso vikāraḥ strīṇāṃ tat pauṃścalyam | anyatrāpi dharmādau kārye 'sthiratā calacittatvāt | ya eva dveṣyaḥ sa eva spṛhyata iti bhrātṛputrādir yo dṛṣṭas tasmā eva kāmukatvena spṛhayanti | sneho rāgas tṛṣṇā ca bhartari putrādau mānavibaddhahṛdayā[40] bhavanti | etair doṣair yogād vikurvate vikriyāṃ bhartṛṣu gacchanti || 9.15 ||
analyzed: yasmin kasmin ca puṃsi dṛṣṭe dhairyāt calanam katham etena saṃprayujyeya iti cetasaḥ vikāraḥ strīṇām tat pauṃścalyam anyatra api dharma ādau kārye sthira tā cala citta tvāt yaḥ eva dveṣyaḥ saḥ eva spṛhyate iti bhrātṛ putra ādiḥ yaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasmai eva kāmuka tvena spṛhayanti snehaḥ rāgaḥ tṛṣṇā ca bhartari putra ādau māna vibaddha hṛdayāḥ bhavanti etaiḥ doṣaiḥ yogāt vikurvate vikriyām bhartṛṣu gacchanti

original: śayyā śayanaṃ svapnaśīlatvam | āsanam anabhyutthānaśīlatā | alaṃkāraḥ śarīramaṇḍanam[44] | kāmaṃ puruṣopabhogaspṛhā | krodho dveṣaḥ | anāryatā snigdhe 'pi dveṣo dviṣṭe 'pi snehaḥ ākārasaṃvaraṇaṃ nirddharmatā | drogdhṛbhāvaḥ | drogdhṛtvaṃ bhartṛpitrādeḥ, puruṣavyasanīyatayādharmātmakatvaṃ bhartrādīnām[45] | druheḥ kartari tṛcā bhāvaśabdena samāsaḥ | kucaryā nīcapuruṣasevanam | eṣa svabhāvaḥ strīṇāṃ manunā sargādau kalpitaḥ | śayyāsaṇālaṃkārā drohakucaryayor dṛṣṭāntatvenopadīyante | yathaite padārthāḥ svabhāvabhūtā avicālitā evaṃ kucaryādayo 'pi || 9.17 ||
analyzed: śayyā śayanam svapna śīla tvam āsanam anabhyutthāna śīla tā alaṃkāraḥ śarīra maṇḍanam kāmam puruṣa upabhoga spṛhā krodhaḥ dveṣaḥ anārya tā snigdhe dveṣaḥ dviṣṭe pi snehaḥ ākāra saṃvaraṇam nirddharma tā drogdhṛ bhāvaḥ drogdhṛ tvam bhartṛ pitṛ ādeḥ puruṣa vyasanīya tayā adharma ātmaka tvam bhartṛ ādīnām druheḥ kartari tṛcāḥ bhāva śabdena samāsaḥ kucaryā nīca puruṣa sevanam eṣa svabhāvaḥ strīṇām manunā sarga

original: ato ye kecid aviśeṣeṇa[47] mantrapratiṣedho 'yam iti varṇayanti, tataś ca pratiṣedhaṃ manyamānā yat kiṃcit srīsaṃbandhi karma yena kena cit kriyate[48] — yatra[49] striyaḥ kartṛtayā saṃbadhyante sāyaṃbaliharaṇādau, tathā saṃskāryatayā cūḍādiṣu, saṃpradānatayā śrāddhādau — tatra sarvatra mantrapratiṣedhād amantrakaṃ strīṇāṃ śrāddhādi karyam iti |
analyzed: atas ye kecid aviśeṣeṇa mantra pratiṣedhaḥ yam iti varṇayanti tatas ca pratiṣedham manyamānāḥ yat kiṃcid srī saṃbandhi karma yena kena cit kriyate yatra striyaḥ kartṛ tayā saṃbadhyante sāyam bali haraṇa ādau tathā saṃskārya tayā cūḍa ādiṣu saṃpradāna tayā śrāddha ādau tatra sarvatra mantra pratiṣedhāt amantrakam strīṇām śrāddha ādi karyam iti

original: te[50] 'yuktavādino[51] 'nyaparatvād asya | arthavādatayā[52] yad asti tadālambananyāyena[53] vihitapratiṣedhamantrasaṃbandhamantracūḍāsaṃskārāpekṣaṃ vyākhyeyam etat | adhyayanābhāvāc ca prāyaścittamantrajapābhāvaḥ prekṣayā[54] |
analyzed: te yuktavādinaḥ nya para tvāt asya arthavāda tayā yat asti tad ālambana nyāyena vihita pratiṣedha mantra saṃbandha mantra cūḍā saṃskāra apekṣam vyākhyeyam etat adhyayana abhāvāt ca prāyaścitta mantra japa abhāvaḥ prekṣayā

original: nirindiryāḥ | indriyaṃ vīryaṃ dharyaprajñābalādi tāsāṃ nāsty ato 'nicchantyo 'pi kadācit pāpācārair balenākramyante | tato rakṣituṃ yuktāḥ | striyo 'nṛtam[55] iti śīlasnehayor asthiratvād[56] anṛtavacanena[57] nindyate || 9.18 ||
analyzed: nirindiryāḥ indriyam vīryam dharya prajñā bala ādi tāsām na asti atas kadācid pāpa ācāraiḥ balena ākramyante tatas rakṣitum yuktāḥ striyaḥ iti śīla snehayoḥ asthira tvāt anṛta vacanena nindyate

original: tathā ca śrutayo bahvyo nigītā nigameṣv api |
analyzed: tathā ca śrutayaḥ bahvyaḥ nigītāḥ nigameṣu api

original: svālakṣaṇyaparīkṣārthaṃ tāsāṃ śṛṇuta niṣkṛtīḥ || 9.19 ||
analyzed: svālakṣaṇya parīkṣā artham tāsām śṛṇuta niṣkṛtīḥ

original: svabhāvato 'śuddhahṛdayāḥ striya ity asminn arthe vaidikāni mantrārthavādarūpāṇi vākyāni sākṣitvenopanyasyati | tathā ca | yathā mayoktam "striyo 'nṛtam" iti tathaiva nigameṣu vedeṣu śrutayaḥ santi | nigamaśabdo vedaparyāyo dṛṣṭaprayogaś ca | "babhūthātatantha ityādi nigame"[58] (Pāṇ 7.2.64) |[59] vedārthavyākhyānāṅgavacano 'py asti | nigamaniruktavyākaraṇāny aṅgānīti | nirukte hi prayogaḥ "nigamā ime bhavanti" (Nir 1.1) iti | tasyeha śrutigrahaṇād vā vakṣyamāṇodāharaṇāc cāsaṃbhavaḥ[60] | ato vedavacano nigamaśabda iha gṛhyate | samudāyāvayavabhedāc cādhārādheyabhāvaḥ | teṣu nigameṣu śrutaya ekadeśabhūtā[61] vākyāni nigītā adhītāḥ saṃśabditāḥ paṭhyanta iti yāvat | nityapravṛtte ca kālāvibhāgādi niruktam[62] |
analyzed: svabhāvataḥ śuddha hṛdayāḥ striyaḥ iti asmin arthe vaidikāni mantra arthavāda rūpāṇi vākyāni sākṣi tvena upanyasyati tathā ca yathā mayā uktam striyaḥ iti tathā eva nigameṣu vedeṣu śrutayaḥ santi nigama śabdaḥ veda paryāyaḥ dṛṣṭa prayogaḥ ca babhūtha atatantha ityādi nigama

original: pāṭhāntaraṃ "nigadā"[63] iti | nigadā mantraviśeṣāḥ | śrutayo brāhmaṇavākyāni | mantreṣu brāhmaṇeṣu cāyam artho darśito yad anṛtā striya iti | bahvyas tāḥ santīty asmin pakṣe 'dhyāhāraḥ | tāsāṃ śrutīnāṃ yā yā niṣkṛtirūpā vyabhicāraprāyaścittabhūtās tāḥ[64] śṛṇuta | kim artham udāhriyanta iti cet, svālakṣaṇyaparīkṣārtham | svalakṣaṇaṃ nityasaṃnihitasvabhāvas tatpratipādanārtham | aṅgadakuṇḍalādi yal lakṣaṇaṃ[65] tatparibhūtam idaṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ svabhāva ity arthaḥ | etad āsāṃ svalakṣaṇaṃ yad vyabhicārātmakam[66] || 9.19 ||
analyzed: pāṭha antaram nigadāḥ iti nigadāḥ mantra viśeṣāḥ śrutayaḥ brāhmaṇa vākyāni mantreṣu brāhmaṇeṣu ca ayam arthaḥ darśitaḥ yat anṛtāḥ striyaḥ iti bahvyaḥ tāḥ santi iti asmin pakṣe dhyāhāraḥ tāsām śrutīnām yāḥ yāḥ niṣkṛti rūpāḥ vyabhicāra prāyaścitta bhūtāḥ tāḥ śṛṇuta kim artham udāhriyante iti ced svālakṣaṇya parīkṣā artham sva lakṣaṇam nitya saṃnihita svabhāvaḥ tad pratipādana artham aṅgada kuṇḍala

original: yan me mātā pralulubhe vicaranty apativratā |
analyzed: yat me mātā pralulubhe vicarantī apativratā

original: tan me retaḥ pitā vṛṅktām ity asyaitan nidarśanam || 9.20 ||
analyzed: tat me retaḥ pitā vṛṅktām iti asya etat nidarśanam

original: itikāraṇāntena[67] pādatrayeṇa mantraikadeśo 'nukṛtaḥ | yan me mātā apativratā: patyur anyapuruṣe na kāmaś cetasāpīti yasyā vrataṃ niyamaḥ sā pativratā | tadviparītā apativratā | vicarantī paragṛhān gacchantī | tatrojvalaveṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā pralulubhe | lobhaṃ spṛhām anyapuruṣaṃ prati kṛtavatī | tat pāpaṃ mamotpattyā matpituḥ[68] saṃbandhi yad retaḥ śukraṃ tad vṛṅktām apanudatu | tadretasā sa doṣo 'pamṛjyatām | piteti ṣaṣṭhīsthāne prathamā vyatyayena | atha vā reta eva pitṛtvena parikalpyate[69] | aparityaktasvaliṅga eva retasā sāmānādhikaraṇyam anubhavati | "dyaur me pitā" (RV 2.3.20) iti yathā | atha vā mātṛbījam apy ucyate retaḥ[70] | tad retaḥ pitā janako vṛṅktāṃ śodhayatām |[71] pitṛjabījaprabhāvena mātṛdoṣo 'panudyatām ity arthaḥ | asya vyabhicārātmakasyaitan nidarśanaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ | sarve japamānā[72] etaṃ mantram uccārayanti | yadi ca sarvāḥ striyo duṣṭasvabhāvās tato mantrasya nityavat prayogopapattir itarathā pākṣikaḥ syāt | cāturmāsyeṣv ayaṃ mantro viniyuktaḥ pādyānumantraṇe ca śrāddhe || 9.20 ||
analyzed: iti kāraṇa antena pāda trayeṇa mantra eka deśaḥ nu kṛtaḥ yat me mātā apativratā patyuḥ anya puruṣe na kāmaḥ cetasā api iti yasyāḥ vratam niyamaḥ sā pativratā tad viparītā apativratā vicarantī para gṛhān gacchantī tatra ujvala veṣam dṛṣṭvā pralulubhe lobham spṛhām anya puruṣam prati kṛtavatī tat pāpam mama utpattyāḥ mad pituḥ saṃbandhi yat retaḥ śukram tat vṛṅktām apanudatu tat retasā sa doṣaḥ upamṛjyatām pitā iti ṣaṣṭhī

original: dhyāyaty aniṣṭaṃ yat kiṃcit pāṇigrāhasya cetasā |

analyzed: tasya eṣa vyabhicarasya nihnavaḥ samyak ucyate

original: pāṇigrāho bhartā | tasya cetasā yad aniṣṭam apriyaṃ parapuruṣasaṃparkādikaṃ strī cintayati tasya mānasasya vyabhicārasya nihnavaḥ śuddhir anena mantreṇa karmaṇi niyuktenocyate | prasaṅgān mantraprayojanaṃ darśitam | yady api karmaguṇataiva karmāṅgamantraprayojanaṃ tathāpi japādau viniyogān mānasavyabhicāranivṛttyarthatāpy[73] ucyate || 9.21 ||
analyzed: pāṇigrāhaḥ bhartā tasya cetasā yat aniṣṭam apriyam para puruṣa saṃparka ādikam strī cintayati tasya mānasasya vyabhicārasya nihnavaḥ śuddhiḥ anena mantreṇa karmaṇi niyuktena ucyate prasaṅgāt mantra prayojanam darśitam yadi api karma guṇa tā eva karma aṅga mantra prayojanam tathā api japa ādau viniyogāt mānasa vyabhicāra nivṛtti artha tā api ucyate

original: yādṛgguṇena bhartrā strī saṃyujyeta yathāvidhi |
analyzed: yādṛgguṇena bhartrā strī saṃyujyeta yathāvidhi

original: bhāryāsaṃrakṣaṇakāmena dauḥśīlyād ātmā rakṣitavyaḥ | nāpy etayaiva kevalayā | yato[74] duḥśīlasya bhāryāpi tathāvidhair bhavati, guṇavataḥ śīlavatī | yathā samudreṇa nimnagā nadī saṃyujyamānā kṣārodakā bhavati madhurarasāpi satī || 9.22 ||

analyzed: śāraṅgī mandapālena jagāma abhyarhaṇīya tām

analyzed: hīna jātīyā api akṣamālā vasiṣṭha bhāryā tad saṃyogāt abhyarhaṇīya tām prāptā śāraṅgī tiryak jātiḥ caṭakā mandapālena muninā saṃyuktā tathā eva pūjyā atas hīna jātīyāḥ kanīyasyaḥ u pi bhūyas bhartṛ vat pūjyāḥ tathā ca uktam vayasi striyaḥ iti

original: yac coktaṃ[366] "svadāratas tu niyamātikramaḥ prāpnoti" iti | na hy asyāyam arthaḥ: svadārebhyo 'nyā gantavyeti | parastriyaṃ ca na[367] kāmayate na cāparān dārān | tathā saty anenaiva gatatvāt paradārapratiṣedho 'narthakaḥ syāt | kiṃ tarhi svadāreṣu ratir dhārayitavyā ratibhāvanayābhyāsāt prītyatiśayotpatteḥ | "striyaṃ ca na kāmayate na cāparān dārāṃs tathā sati dharmebhyo na hīyate" ity anuvādo 'yam | atha vā svadāranirato 'pi parvavarjanam enāṃ vrajeyuḥ | asau suṣuptyaivam apatyaseṣa eva | paradārāpratiṣedho 'pi nāsti | anūḍhatvāt kenacid dāravyapadeśābhāvāt |
analyzed: yat ca uktam sva dārataḥ tu niyama atikramaḥ prāpnoti iti na hi asya ayam arthaḥ sva dārebhyaḥ nyā gantavyā iti para striyam ca na kāmayate na ca aparān dārān tathā sati anena eva gata tvāt para dāra pratiṣedhaḥ narthakaḥ syāt kim tarhi sva dāreṣu ratiḥ dhārayitavyā rati bhāvanayā abhyāsāt prīti atiśaya utpatteḥ striyam ca na kāmayate na ca aparān dārān tathā sati dharmebhyaḥ na hīyate iti anuvādaḥ yam atha vā sva dāra nirataḥ parva varjanam enām vra

original: kiṃ punar atra yuktam avivāhyeti | aṣṭau hi vivāhāḥ | te ca svīkārabhedena brāhmādivyapadeśabhedaṃ pratipadyante | na cāsyāḥ svakaraṇaṃ bhartur asti, pitur eva svatvānativṛtteḥ | abhrātṛkāyāṃ ca vivāhapratiṣedhe putrikām avivāhyāṃ darśayati | yathā "nābhrātṛkām upayaccheta tokaṃ hy asya tad bhavati " iti | prākaraṇikaś cāyaṃ pratiṣedhas tadatikrame vivāhasya saṃskārataiva nāsti śūdrādyādhānasyevāhavanīyādyarhatā[368] raniginyādipratiṣedheṣūpalabhyamānamūlatvāt[369] prakaraṇādhīno 'pi saṃskāratvam apanudati | tathā ca śiṣṭā[370] darśanīyakanyābhāve kapilādirūpām upayacchanti | tathā ca sahadharmānuṣṭhānam[371] ācaranti | kṣatayonyanyapūrvābhāvo 'tra[372] samānapravarādikayoḍhayāpi kathaṃcin na patnīkāryaṃ kurvanti | etadartham eva kaiścin "nodvahet kapilām" (MDh 3.8) ity atra dṛṣṭadoṣopavarṇanam, prākaraṇikatve 'pi sapiṇḍādipratiṣedhasya caikarūpyaṃ mā vijñāyīti |
analyzed: kim punar atra yuktam avivāhyā iti aṣṭau hi vivāhāḥ te ca svīkāra bhedena brāhma ādi vyapadeśa bhedam pratipadyante na ca asyāḥ svakaraṇam bhartuḥ asti pituḥ eva sva tva anativṛtteḥ abhrātṛkāyām ca vivāha pratiṣedhe putrikām avivāhyām darśayati yathā na abhrātṛkām upayaccheta tokam hi asya tat bhavati iti prākaraṇikaḥ ca ayam pratiṣedhaḥ tad atikrame vivāhasya saṃskāra tā eva na asti śūdra ādi ādhānasya iva āhavanīya ādi arhatā raniginyādi

original: kathaṃ punaḥ spaṣṭapratiṣedho[373] bhrātṛkām upayacchate tasmin noddvāhaśaṅkā[374] |
analyzed: katham punar spaṣṭa pratiṣedhaḥ bhrātṛkām upayacchate tasmin na uddvāha śaṅkā

original: ucyate | asya pratiṣedhasya vākyaśeṣaḥ śrūyate: "apatyaṃ hy asya tad bhavati" iti anena | tataś cāpatyotpattāv eva putrikā na bhāryā dharmārtham | arthakāmayos tv astv eva sahādhikāra iti |

original: asya cārthaḥ | ya evaṃlakṣaṇaḥ sa iha śastre kānīnagrahaṇeṣu grahītavyaḥ | sa ca kasyāpatyam ity apekṣāyām "voḍhuḥ kanyāsamudbhavam" iti dvitīyaṃ vākyam | atha vā neha padārtho lakṣyate | kiṃ tarhi, saṃbandhitā niyamyate | ya evaṃvidhaḥ kānīnas taṃ voḍhuḥ saṃbandhinaṃ vaded ity ekavākyataiva | saṃbandhitā ca padārthabhede cāpy upādhibhedād bhidyata eva rahaḥprakāśabhedena |[379] anye cāhur yady padārthaḥ sa eva tadā[380] kānīnaśabdasya śabdārthasaṃbandho 'badhita evāvagantavyaḥ | te ced apatyamātre kānīnaṃ smaranti,[381] bhavatu paitṛke kānīne vyavahāraḥ |
analyzed: asya ca arthaḥ yaḥ evaṃlakṣaṇaḥ saḥ iha śastre kānīna grahaṇeṣu grahītavyaḥ sa ca kasya apatyam iti apekṣāyām voḍhuḥ kanyā samudbhavam iti dvitīyam vākyam atha vā na iha padārthaḥ lakṣyate kim tarhi saṃbandhi tā niyamyate yaḥ evaṃvidhaḥ kānīnaḥ tam voḍhuḥ saṃbandhinam vadet iti eka vākya tā eva saṃbandhi tā ca padārtha bhede ca api upādhi bhedāt bhidyate eva rahaḥ prakāśa bhedena anye ca āhuḥ yadi padārthaḥ saḥ eva tadā kānīn

original: āryaṃ[636] śāstranoditam[637] kartavyam itarānuṣṭhānaniṣedhaḥ[638] | tadvṛttaṃ yeṣām ity uttarapadalopī samāsaḥ | tena[639] dīnānāthaśrotriyā akaraśulkadā gṛhyante | tadrakṣaṇād dhi tridivagamanaṃ yuktam | anyeṣāṃ tu vṛttiparikrītatvād akaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ, yathottaratra vakṣyate "svargāc ca parihīyate" (MDh 9.254) iti | rakṣānuvṛttiniṣkrayaṇena[640] pratyavāyābhāvamātram, na tu svargaḥ | atha vā vṛttiniyamāpekṣaṃ tridivaprāptivacanam, yathoktaṃ prāk | anyeṣāṃ[641] tu vṛttiparikrītatvadarśanam[642] | arthavādamātraṃ rājñaḥ svargavacanam | avṛttidaparipālanam api[643] vṛttiprayuktaṃ svarājyabhāgasthānīyasya tadrājñaḥ[644] | yathaiva ca śilpijīvinaḥ "śilpino māsi māsy ekaikaṃ karma[645] kuryuḥ" (GDh 10.31) iti vṛttyarthaṃ śilpaṃ kurvāṇā rājñā karma kāryante karagrahaṇāya, evaṃ rājāpi vṛttiyuktaḥ prajāpālanapravṛtto nityakarmavad āryaparipālanaṃ[646] kāryate śāstreṇa | yathaiva hi kāmaśrutito[647] 'gnyāhito nityāny[648] anutiṣṭhati, na svargādilābhāya | na hi tāni phalārthatayā noditāni, atha ca kriyante | tadvad etad draṣṭavyam | ato yāvatī kācit phalaśrutiḥ sā sarvārthavāda iti kovaraviṣṇusvāmī[649] | yad atra tattvaṃ tad darśitam adhastāt || 9.253 ||

original: utkocakā ye[661] kasyacit kāryeṇa kasyacid rājāmātyādeḥ pravṛttau arthagrahaṇena kāryasiddhau[662] pravartate | aupadhikāḥ chadmavyavahāriṇaḥ | anyad bruvanty anyad ācaranti | pratyakṣaṃ prītiṃ darśayitvā haṭhopakāre[663] vartante | vināpy arthagrahaṇena nimittāntarataḥ anyato 'parasya kāryasiddhim avaśyaṃ vijñāya "mayā tavaitat kriyate" iti paraṃ gṛhṇanti | bhīṣikāpradarśanaṃ vā upadhiḥ | vañcakāḥ kitavā dhanagrahaṇārthe[664] sadā devina ity arthaḥ | pṛthag arthe vā padaṃ vañcakā[665] vipralambhakāḥ | "idaṃ kāryaṃ vayam eva kariṣyāmas tava nānyatrasthā"[666] ity uktvā na kurvate[667] | upetya nānākārair nānāvidhair[668] upāyair grāminān muṣṇanti | śivamādhavādayaḥ śivam ādityaṃ upajīvanti[669] | maṅgalādeśavṛttā śāntyupadeśikā[670] jyotiṣikādayaḥ | atha vā "etāṃ devatāṃ tvadarthenāhaṃ prīṇayāmi durgāṃ mārtaṇḍaṃ ca" iti tathāḍhyānāṃ dhanam upajīvanti | atha vā "maṅgalaṃ tavāstu"[671] iti vādinaḥ maṅgalādeśavṛttāḥ[672] | abhadrā bhadrāḥ | prekṣaṇikāḥ sarvasya karadarśanena praśaṃsanti puruṣalakṣaṇāni[673] || 9.258 ||
analyzed: utkocakāḥ ye kasyacid kāryeṇa kasyacid rāja amātya ādeḥ pravṛttau artha grahaṇena kārya siddhau pravartate aupadhikāḥ chadma vyavahāriṇaḥ anyat bruvanti anyat ācaranti pratyakṣam prītim darśayitvā haṭha upakāre vartante vinā api artha grahaṇena nimitta antarataḥ parasya kārya siddhim avaśyam vijñāya mayā tava etat kriyate iti param gṛhṇanti bhīṣikā pradarśanam vā upadhiḥ vañcakāḥ kitavāḥ dhana grahaṇa arthe sadā devinaḥ iti arthaḥ pṛccha
